Privacy notice

What we collect. When you create a FARUMA account we store your name, email address, and a securely hashed password. As you use the app we keep a record of your credit balance and credit transactions (when credits were used or added).

What we do with it. This information is used only to run your account, track your credits, and improve FARUMA. We do not sell or share your personal information with anyone.

Where it is stored. Account data is stored securely with Supabase. The text you type when generating lesson plans is processed by Anthropic's Claude API to produce your documents and is not used to identify you.

Generated documents. Lesson plans, schemes of work and other documents you generate are saved in your own browser on your device, not on our servers.

Your choices. You can ask for your account and its data to be deleted at any time by contacting the FARUMA administrator at your school.

    About FARUMA

    FARUMA is an AI-powered planning assistant built for Maldivian teachers. Every lesson plan, scheme of work, checklist, assessment and report comment is aligned to the Maldives National Curriculum.

    Pick a tool, choose your grade, subject and outcomes, and FARUMA drafts ready-to-use material in your school's own format — so you spend less time formatting and more time teaching.

    Alongside lesson plans and schemes of work, FARUMA plans project based learning units, real-world project tasks with marking rubrics, and printable or classroom games built from your own syllabus.

    Curriculum-aligned planning for Maldivian teachers · edu.carthage@gmail.com

    Project Based Learning

    Plan a multi-week unit — driving question, entry event, milestones with a critique round, a public product and a separate knowledge check. Group size and length are set automatically by key stage. For a single task with one product and one rubric, use Projects.

    📚 Select National Curriculum Standard
    Choose grade, subject, strand & outcome — the whole project is built from these codes.
    Project shape
    ● 2 creditsCharged only if the plan is generated. Unused credits are returned automatically.
    Your project plan
    Projects

    One task, one product, one rubric. Pick your outcomes and what students will make — FARUMA writes a real-world question and a rubric with a criterion for every indicator, in “I can…” success-criteria language.

    📚 Select National Curriculum Standard
    Every indicator you select becomes one row of the rubric. Three to five is the sweet spot.
    Final product
    What will students actually make? This shapes the question, the craft criterion and the time estimate.
    Rubric
    ● 1 creditCharged only if the task is generated. Unused credits are returned automatically.
    Your task
    Games

    Printable puzzles are built on your device straight from the syllabus vocabulary — no AI, no credits, works offline. Classroom games are written for you and always come with a debrief step.

    📚 Select National Curriculum Standard
    Choose grade, subject, strand & outcome — the word bank and the game are built from these codes.
    Word bank
    Pulled from your indicators. Click a word to remove it. Add your own below.
    ● 1 credit AI reads your indicators and writes curriculum vocabulary with a child-friendly clue for each word. Clues are used by the crossword, matching pairs and loop cards.
    Printable puzzles
    ● Free — no creditsBuilt on your device. Every word is checked before the sheet prints.
    Classroom games
    Written for you, with rules, materials, a no-tech version and a mandatory debrief tying strategy back to the concept.
    ● 1 creditCharged only if the game is generated. Unused credits are returned automatically.
